scoring_justification: T0 result-level compare: headline magnetic moments are provided by the agent; recomputing from raw SIESTA outputs is not feasible in the verifier, so we compare reported values to the paper's gold with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold magnetic moments for the ten configurations from paper Table 1.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from paper: pristine 0.0, B-sp2-in 1.00, B-sp3 0.93, B-sp2-out 1.00, O-sp2-in 0.00, O-sp3 2.00, O-sp2-out 0.00, N-sp2-in 1.00, N-sp3 0.92, N-sp2-out 1.00.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's exact reported numbers, verified against the text.

outputs.description: The computed magnetic moments for each doping configuration.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares the reported magnetic moments to reference values with an appropriate tolerance. No formation energies, band structures, or PDOS are required; only the magnetic moments are scored.
